description: One console request. intent says what to do; for intent spawn the other fields describe one object, which may be an assembly of simple parts. The sizes are requests: a validator rescales or refuses them.

intent.description: spawn: make an object. set_gravity: change gravity. home: send the arm home. help: list commands. none: anything else. Never stop or resume: the browser handles those itself.

gravity.description: For set_gravity, which setting; otherwise none.

kind.description: Which generator makes the shape. assembly is for recognisable things built from parts; box, cylinder, sphere and cone are for simple everyday things; asteroid, panel, dish, bus and fragment are for space things.

name.description: Short display name of the thing asked for, such as electric guitar, helicopter or skateboard.

width_mm.description: Requested width across, in millimetres. Quote the size the person asked for, even if huge.

depth_mm.description: Kind box only: depth front to back in millimetres, when it differs from the width.

roughness.description: Small surface detail, 0 smooth to 1 rough.

lumpiness.description: Large shape variation, 0 regular to 1 lumpy.

seed.description: Random seed. Same seed, same shape.

material.description: Material. It sets density and friction.

name.description: What the part is, one or two words: stock, barrel, wing, wheel.

size_mm.description: Real-world size in millimetres. box: length (x), width (y), height (z). cylinder: diameter, diameter, length along its axis (z before rotation). sphere: diameters. cone: base diameter, base diameter, height.

pos_mm.description: Centre of the part in the object frame, millimetres, x forward along the length, y across, z up.

rot_deg.description: Rotation in degrees about x, then y, then z. [0, 90, 0] lays a cylinder along x; tilt a box with a small x or y angle.

parts.description: Kind assembly only: 3 to 8 coloured parts at real-world proportions in millimetres. A validator rescales the whole object.

why.description: One short sentence on why these values fit the request.
